sources.note: agilon health homepage. Describes company as value-based care enablement platform for senior care. No mention of EHR, Minerva, or clinical software — focuses on physician partnerships and platform model.

ONC Health IT disclosure page. Describes Minerva V4 as having two functional areas: interoperability platform (data aggregation into unified FHIR record) and patient engagement (web/mobile apps for data access, appointments, messaging).
March 2023 press release announcing agilon's $45M acquisition of mphrX. Describes Minerva as FHIR-based data aggregation platform for clinical data integration.
Becker's coverage of the $45M mphrX acquisition. Confirms acquisition price and timeline.

Frost & Sullivan 2020 award for Minerva. Detailed description: deployed in 20+ countries, 460M+ patient records, 52M+ active patient accounts, 350K+ clinical users. Aggregates data from EMRs, HIS, PACS. Features include clinical viewer, patient apps, analytics, care coordination.

mphrX Minerva platform page (site offline at time of research, info from search snippets). Describes FHIR-native data aggregation, data connectors, bulk-FHIR APIs, SMART on FHIR framework, and data warehouse streaming.
mphrX virtual care solutions page (site offline, info from search snippets). Describes telemedicine capabilities, on-demand/scheduled virtual visits.
mphrX care coordination page (site offline, info from search snippets). Describes surgery coordination features — intelligent task allocation, alerts, notifications, stakeholder views.
mphrX surgery coordination page (site offline, info from search snippets). Claims 50% reduction in surgery cancellations.
mphrX digital front door page (site offline, info from search snippets). White-labeled patient portal, appointment booking, health data access.
2022 announcement of mphrX/Mount Sinai partnership for real-time clinical data sharing. Could not access full content (503 error).
Minerva Patient Engagement Suite on Azure Marketplace. Confirms white-labeled mobile apps and web portal for patient engagement.
agilon 2025 partnerships press release. Confirms 3,000+ PCPs, 700K+ senior patients, 30+ communities.
